rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for the animal.

example.english: That gorilla at the zoo is huge.
example.traditional: 動物園嗰隻大猩猩好大隻。
example.jyutping: dung6 mat6 jyun4 go2 zek3 daai6 sing1 sing1 hou2 daai6 zek3

rows.note: Use this for a physically big, brutish man rather than for a specifically hired thug.

example.english: That gorilla by the door always looks surly.
example.traditional: 門口嗰個大隻佬成日黑口黑面。
example.jyutping: mun4 hau2 go2 go3 daai6 zek3 lou2 seng4 jat6 hak1 hau2 hak1 min6

rows.note: Use this when the gorilla is specifically an enforcer or thug.

example.english: They hired a gorilla to collect debts.
example.jyutping: keoi5 ceng2 zo2 go3 daa2 sau2 heoi3 sau1 sou3

rows.note: Use this for a powerful person or organization treated as a heavyweight.

example.english: This company is a gorilla in the industry.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai6 jip6 gaai3 geoi6 tau4
